title: commercial opportunities - u.s. embassy to angola and sao tome and principe
paragraphs: we are open to receiving proposals/quotations from companies interested in providing this service for a one-year, renewable term, with an anticipated start date of december 1, 2026. we are hereby officially requesting your company’s pricing for a 50mbps internet service, that is, a connection that supports simultaneous upload and download at the same speed. please see the attachment for detailed information on the requirements for this circuit. for any clarification regarding the technical aspects, please do not hesitate to contact my colleagues from the embassy’s technology department, who are copied on this email. please provide a quotation indicating the following costs: installation costs monthly costs (50mbps) applicable taxes (vat or other) the u.s. embassy intends to award these services to companies that accept and comply with the terms and conditions of the u.s. government purchase order. this request for quotations will remain open for proposals for 10 days from the date of publication of this announcement, october 7, 2026. for other, non-technical questions, please contact us by email at luandaprocurement@state.gov . read all the requirements here
